title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (railsfindsql) — review required
description: In railsfindsql, find_by_sql("SELECT #{q}") mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via finder methods.
applicability: railsfindsql data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
